title: Kiosk Panel Mirror Audit
brief: Industrial designers lay out a kiosk's control panel as a binary tree of TreeNode objects, where each node is a control and its children are the controls split beneath it to the left and right. Brand guidelines require the panel to look identical when reflected across its vertical center line.
Implement isMirrorBalanced(root), where root is the top control, and return true if the left half of the tree is a mirror image of the right half, and false otherwise.
